decisions.ask: The late-fee code and its test are written and passing, but not committed: the loans file under app/lending holds a change I did not make. How should the commit go?

recommended.door: You say commit, and I commit only the two new files, leaving your loans change pending.
recommended.why: Neither new file uses the added MAX_RENEWALS line, and the commit can be undone.
recommended.reverses_if: the loans change is meant to ship together with the late fee

others.what_it_does: You commit or set aside the loans change yourself, then invoke the task again and I commit the two new files.

decisions.if_none: Nothing is committed; the new files and your loans change stay as they are.
